CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.btcsp_touch_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END;
$function$

constraints.name: projects_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: snapshot_owned_project_fk
